Definition: Dan, one of the sons of Jacob; also the tribe descended from him, and its territory; likewise a place in Palestine colonized by them
BiblicalUsage: Dan = "a judge"; 1) the 5th son of Jacob, the 1st of Bilhah, Rachel's handmaid; 2) the tribe descended from Dan, the son of Jacob; n pr loc; 3) a city in Dan, the most northern landmark of Palestine
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
